0022600200.text: Boston arrives for its 10th game of the season at 7-2, including a 2-2 road record and a two-game winning streak, and sits 2nd in the Atlantic (0.5 games back) and 2nd in the East. Milwaukee is 1-7, on a four-game losing streak, and sits 5th in the Central (5 games back) and 15th in the East. Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 109-102 win in Boston on November 4, 2026, and the Celtics also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
